newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea yields close flat, heavy new issues affect.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea yields close flat, heavy new issues affect.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates closed flat on Monday as heavy new issues depressed sentiment, dealers said.
Three-month CDs also ended unchanged in slow trading, while overnight call rate edged up on rising money demand in the shorter-term money market, they said.
* Overnight call average 11.20 pct vs 11.00 pct

Brokers said three-month CDs closed unchanged in slow trading and overnight call rate edged up to 11.20 percent from 11.00 percent as banks were in need of cash to meet their reserve requirements at the Bank of Korea.
